NLP metrics like BLEU, ROUGE, and METEOR are utilized to evaluate the closeness of the generated description to the ground truth description. We also adopt Text2Mol metric, which is proposed by Edwards et al. ( ) and employ pre-trained models to measure the similarity between the description and ground truth molecule.
